name: CHORD Material Estimation
description: Full SVBRDF estimation from a single texture photo (Ubisoft LaForge CHORD): basecolor, normal, roughness and metalness in one diffusion pass. Independent of the CHORD Height recipe -- this node never touches height, and CHORD Height never touches these four maps. Requires chord_v1.safetensors in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints (gated download, license must be accepted on the Ubisoft Hugging Face repo first).
